name: Ben Evers
source:
Ben is a virtual reality enthusiast in his late teens, living in Los Angeles and working multiple minimum wage jobs to support himself. He moved away from home as soon as he was able, escaping an unstable and abusive family dynamic. Ben is a cheerful, upbeat kind of guy - most people would never guess that his life has been so hard. 

Although kind and friendly, Ben has no one he considers a true friend. To take his mind off things, Ben plays Full Realms, the virtual reality MMO, in every moment of his precious spare time. He is thrilled to be a Penta beta tester.
